name: Quinigua
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Extinct, unclassified (NE Mexico); known only from a short wordlist; no descriptive references listed.

sources.citation: Hoyo, Eugenio del. 1960. Vocablos de la lengua quinigua de los indios borrados del noreste de México. Humanitas (Anuario del Centro de Estudios Humanísticos, Universidad de Nuevo León) 1: 489-517.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. The only primary source: 17th-18th-century band names from the Monterrey municipal archive with Spanish glosses, a morpheme-cutting attempt (pp. 504-509) and a morpheme list (pp. 510-515); no phonetic/phonological section; author says the colonial scribes 'no conocían la lengua ni tenían la menor noción de la fonética' (p. 499). scanned a full-text search for stress/accent acent/tónic/sílaba/stress: no hits.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 entry quin1252 (Unclassifiable, extinct, MX); English and Spanish Wikipedia 'Quinigua language' / 'Idioma quinigua'.
sources.note: Glottolog lists no descriptive references; Wikipedia articles cite only Hoyo 1960 and Gursky 1964 and say nothing about phonology.

sources.citation: Wichmann, Søren (ed.). 2024. The Languages and Linguistics of Mexico and Northern Central America: A Comprehensive Guide. De Gruyter Mouton (chapter with a Naolan/Quinigua comparison table).
